title: SCROLLING_TEXT AnimationConfig
description: Animation config entry for scrolling text in toy-config.json

text.description: The text to render and scroll as a marquee

font.description: Asset path to the bitmap font JSON file (e.g., 'fonts/default.json')

frameIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between scroll steps (each step = 1 column shift)

trailingIntervalMs.description: Pause in ms after scroll completes (before fade-back to image)
